== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] Gate, also known as the Gate to [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], is a red-bordered [[portal]] that serves as an entrance or exit to the [[Territory]] of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]]. These gates can appear as swirling circular openings in the air or on walls, often characterized by a slight red glow at their edges. A gate to the [[Crimson Vault]] specifically provides access to a cavern containing silver doors marked with the image of a one-eyed, bearded king. While these portals can be opened within the world, they cannot be opened while in the Territories. Travel through these gates is often directional; for instance, entering the [[Crimson Vault]] can lead an individual directly to the royal palace in [[Cana]], specifically near the [[Hanging Tree]]. The gates are highly sought after for rapid travel, potentially allowing users to move between locations in mere seconds. Access to the [[Crimson Vault]] is restricted by an ancient pact, with only [[Leah]] and her two sisters being able to open them. Beyond transportation, the gates serve a defensive role, as guards are stationed to intercept any uninvited creatures that might emerge from them. Although native life within [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] is rarely seen, sounds of growling, hissing, and screaming are frequently heard from within the vaults. The gates are considered significant artifacts and can be utilized by various individuals to facilitate movement during battles or to reach specific rendezvous points.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] Gate is a specific type of [[portal]]. Within the royal palace, an ordinary version of this gate features red borders and serves as a passage leading out from the interior. During certain events, the [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] Gate can be found hanging open behind King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth, who has been observed standing beside a massive instance of the gate.}}
